final_candidates.decision_summary: Position 447 sits in the globular head near the receptor-binding (ephrin-B2/B3) region; a conservative I->T substitution could add a local H-bond and subtly improve receptor engagement with low folding risk. Rationale is structural-domain reasoning only.

Q530 lies at the C-terminal head surface implicated in G-F interaction/triggering; a small Ala substitution could enhance G-to-F crosstalk and fusion triggering without disrupting the head fold. Confidence is modest given lack of direct evidence.
